description: List the valid field names and creator types for a Zotero item type, or list every item type when itemType is omitted. Call this before zotero_create_items with an unfamiliar item type: Zotero rejects a write outright if it carries a field the type does not define.

itemType.description: Item type to describe, e.g. "journalArticle", "book", "thesis", "preprint". Omit to list all types.

name: zotero_get_item_type_fields
title: Describe an item type
